meta.comment: engine.traffic (planned MOD) inc0 table (j): fuel duty (referenced from data/fuel.json, not restated), Vehicle Excise Duty (VED) bands by CO2, congestion-charge/ERP zone defaults, and the COE (Certificate of Entitlement) ownership-quota lever. data/tax_instruments.json's six-instrument set (VAT/import-duties/corporation-tax/PAYE/council-tax/business-rates) has NO VED or road-user-charging instrument today -- this file proposes the DATA for one; wiring it as a seventh engine.tax instrument is an engine change out of inc0's data-only scope (flagged as ASM, see traffic-assumptions.md and the BOW assumption list).
meta.unitsConvention: VED bands in GBP/year (converted to micro-pounds per data/tax_instruments.json's convention, 1 GBP = 1,000,000 micro-pounds, referenced not restated as a NEW unit); congestion charge in GBP/entry or GBP/day; COE price in GBP (one-off, Singapore-style).

fuelDuty.note: referenced, not restated -- this file does not carry its own fuel-duty rate; it exists here only to document that fuel duty is the ROAD-USE tax component this table's demand figures (fuelLitresDemandedPerDay in scale_ladder.json) feed revenue calculations from.

vehicleExciseDuty.$comment: UK VED (road tax) schedule: FIRST-YEAR ('showroom') rate bands by CO2 for cars registered on or after 1 April 2017, 2024-25 DfT published table (BUG-822 fix -- previously mixed first-year and pre-2017 standard-rate figures under one field). The bands below are the complete, non-overlapping, gap-free g/km ladder for THIS ONE schedule -- every co2Band from 0 up covers 0-255+ with no missing range. standardRateFlatGBPPerYear (outside the bands array) is the SEPARATE flat annual rate that applies from the second year of registration onwards for a petrol/diesel car under the same post-2017 schedule -- it is not CO2-banded and must not be confused with a first-year band figure. A future engine increment would need a per-vehicle CO2 rating (not yet modelled) to apply these bands; until then this table's fleetAverageByVehicleClass is usable as a fleet-average road-tax figure per vehicle class.

fleetAverageByVehicleClass.$comment: Directional per-vehicle-class fleet-average VED, used until a real per-vehicle CO2 rating exists in the engine. Derived by mapping vehicle_classes.json's road vehicle classes onto typical real-world fleet CO2 profiles.

car.source: derived approximation (UK average car fleet CO2 sits mid-table across the bands above)

motorbike.note: motorbikes use a separate UK VED schedule by engine size, not CO2; this is a coarse average
motorbike.source: derived approximation, UK motorbike VED schedule order-of-magnitude

taxi.source: as car (private hire vehicles use the standard car VED schedule)

cargo_van.source: derived approximation, UK Light Goods Vehicle VED band order-of-magnitude

rigid_truck.source: derived approximation, UK HGV Road User Levy + VED order-of-magnitude

articulated_truck.source: derived approximation, UK HGV Road User Levy + VED order-of-magnitude (heaviest artic band)

congestionChargeDefault.note: London-style flat daily congestion-charge-zone anchor, mapping sanity-check only
congestionChargeDefault.source: Transport for London Congestion Charge published rate (2024/25 order-of-magnitude)
congestionChargeDefault.confidenceNote: the LONDON rate is measured/published; applying it as this schema's own default is a derived choice

electronicRoadPricingSingaporeStyle.note: Singapore-style ERP: per-gantry-crossing charge, varies by time-of-day and measured v/c to actively manage demand (distinct from London's flat all-day zone charge).
electronicRoadPricingSingaporeStyle.source: Singapore LTA Electronic Road Pricing published rate structure (SGD-denominated originally; GBP figure here is an order-of-magnitude currency-mapping sanity-check, not a live FX conversion)
electronicRoadPricingSingaporeStyle.confidenceNote: the MECHANISM (per-crossing, time-varying) is measured/documented Singapore policy; the specific GBP rate applied here is a derived mapping

certificateOfEntitlement.$comment: Singapore-style COE: a time-limited (10-year) quota-based right to own a vehicle, auctioned; caps fleet growth directly rather than taxing use. Gibraltar's own vehicle-ownership pressure comes from acute land scarcity rather than an auctioned quota, but shares the 'ownership itself is the constrained resource' mechanic Aaron's brief cites both territories for.
certificateOfEntitlement.quotaMechanism: A city-wide (or zone-wide) cap on NEW vehicle registrations per period; price discovered by auction/bid, not fixed.

illustrativePriceGBP.note: Singapore COE prices have historically ranged roughly SGD 30,000-150,000+ depending on vehicle category and market conditions; this is an illustrative order-of-magnitude GBP mapping, not a live or averaged conversion of any specific period's auction result.
illustrativePriceGBP.source: Singapore LTA COE quota premium published results, order-of-magnitude mapping sanity-check

quotaGrowthRatePerYear.note: Singapore's own vehicle-population growth cap has historically been set near zero to slightly negative in recent years; 0.5%/year is this schema's own illustrative default lever, adjustable by policy (see policy_levers.json).
quotaGrowthRatePerYear.source: derived approximation, informed by Singapore LTA vehicle quota policy direction

provenance.source: UK VED published bands (measured), TfL Congestion Charge published rate (measured), Singapore LTA ERP/COE published policy structure (measured mechanism, derived GBP mapping)
provenance.note: VED band RATES and the TfL congestion charge RATE are measured/published UK figures; every Singapore-territory GBP figure is an illustrative order-of-magnitude mapping, not a currency-converted live figure. This whole file is a DATA PROPOSAL for a not-yet-existing engine.tax instrument -- see the ASM entries filed against it.
